title: JANUS Linear A SigLA-native one-sign prefix/suffix minimal-pair morphology discovery
research_question: Does any single SigLA sign repeatedly participate in prefix-like or suffix-like one-sign extension pairs across multiple distinct base word forms, and does that extension behavior reproduce in disjoint document partitions beyond boundary-sign permutation nulls?

source_and_blinding.candidate_identity: Boundary sign ID + side; visible transliteration is inaccessible until all statistical gates are frozen.
source_and_blinding.eligible_word_forms: Only fully resolved hyphen-separated sequences whose components match ^(?:AB|A)[0-9]+[A-Za-z]?$; ambiguous [?], bracketed, composite-hyphen sign IDs and nonstandard components are excluded from claim-bearing morphology scoring.

event_definition.PREFIX_EXTENSION: Both STEM and SIGN+STEM occur as exact eligible word forms within the same partition.
event_definition.SUFFIX_EXTENSION: Both STEM and STEM+SIGN occur as exact eligible word forms within the same partition.
event_definition.candidate_statistic: Number of distinct stem forms extended by the same boundary sign on the same side.
event_definition.support_documents: Distinct documents containing the extended variants for the candidate's observed stem-pair edges.

destructive_null.name: BOUNDARY_SIGN_PERMUTATION_BY_WORD_LENGTH
destructive_null.PREFIX: For every unique eligible word type in a partition, keep its tail/stem and word length fixed; permute first-sign labels among word types of the same length. Recompute which shuffled types still have their base stem attested.
destructive_null.SUFFIX: Keep head/stem and word length fixed; permute final-sign labels among word types of the same length. Recompute extension edges.
preserves: boundary-sign marginal counts within each word length
document-derived support weights attached to word types

SCREEN.multiplicity: Bonferroni across all eligible sign×side hypotheses

reveal: visible sign transliteration if recoverable from SigLA word examples

claim_ceiling.forbidden: Assigning grammatical or lexical meaning to a sign solely from extension topology.

roadmap_after_execution.if_full_survivor: Post-score scholarly novelty audit + independently implemented replay + alternative segmentation control + cross-encoding comparison.
roadmap_after_execution.if_no_full_survivor: Preserve negative result; move to formula-neighborhood / co-occurrence graph community channel without lowering frozen thresholds.
